title.rom: zo4 mak5 gai4, an2, lau1, han2, coi1, bai3
title.en: Why, So, And, Still, At, Time

items.rom: ngi2 | he4 | hak5 ga1 ngin2 | mo1?

items.hak: 厓係半隻客家人，吾爸係潮州人，但吾㜆係新界客家人。你呢？
items.rom: ngai2 | he4 | ban4 zak5 | hak5 ga1 ngin2, nga1 ba1 | he4 | cau2 ziu1 | ngin2, tan4 | nga1 mi1 | he4 | sin1 gai4 | hak5 ga1 ngin2. ngi2 | le1?
items.zh: 我是半個客家人，我爸是潮州人，但我媽是新界客家人。你呢？
items.en: I am half Hakka, my dad is Teochew, but my mom is New Territories Hakka. And you?

items.hak: 厓係馬來西亞客家人，吾屋卡在沙巴。
items.rom: ngai2 | he4 | ma1 loi2 si1 a4 | hak5 ga1 ngin2, nga1 | vuk5 ka1 | coi1 | sa1 ba1.
items.zh: 我是馬來西亞客家人，我家在沙巴。
items.en: I am a Malaysian Hakka, my home is in Sabah.

items.hak: 你係唔係第一擺來香港噢？
items.rom: ngi2 | he4 | m1 he4 | ti4 yit5 bai3 | loi2 | hiong1 gong3 | o1?
items.zh: 你是不是第一次來香港呢？
items.en: Is this your first time coming to Hong Kong?

items.hak: 係呀。做乜介惹客家話講得恁流利嘅？
items.rom: he4 | a1. zo4 mak5 gai4 | ngia1 | hak5 ga1 va4 | gong3 | det5 | an2 | liu2 li4 | e4?
items.zh: 是呀。爲什麼你客家話說得那麼流利的？
items.en: Yes. Why do you speak Hakka so fluently?

items.hak: 因爲吾㜆在屋卡長日摎厓講囉。
items.rom: yin1 vui4 | nga1 mi1 | coi1 | vuk5 ka1 | cong2 ngit5 | lau1 | ngai2 | gong3 | lo1.
items.zh: 因爲我媽在家裏經常跟我說。
items.en: Because my mom often speaks it to me at home.

items.rom: ngi2 | hiau3 | gong3 | cau2 ziu1 va4 | mo1?
items.en: Do you know how to speak Teochew?

items.hak: 曉少少。厓還曉講普通話摎英文。
items.rom: hiau3 | sau3 sau3. ngai2 | han2 hiau3 | gong3 | pu3 tung1 va4 | lau1 | yin1 vun2.
items.zh: 懂一點。我還會講普通話和英文。
items.en: A little bit. I also speak Mandarin and English.

items: 吾爸係客家人/吾爸唔係客家人，佢係...人。
吾㜆係客家人/吾㜆唔係客家人，佢係...人。
係/ 唔係，厓第...擺來香港。

items.zh: {{在}}有兩個發音: (a) **口語音**是 `cói` ({在唔在: coi1 | m1 | coi1}、{在卡: coi1 ka1}); (b) **書面語**唸 `cài` ({自在: cu4 cai4}、{在意: cai4 yi4})。
items.en: {{在}} has two pronunciations: (a) **Spoken**: `cói` ({在唔在: coi1 | m1 | coi1}, {在卡: coi1 ka1}); (b) **Written/Formal**: `cài` ({自在: cu4 cai4}, {在意: cai4 yi4}).

items.zh: {屋: vuk5}的聲母是 `v`，不是**零聲母**。
items.en: The initial consonant of {屋: vuk5} is `v`, not a **zero initial**.

items.zh: 客家話的{曉: hiau3}有兩個意思: (a) 表示能力 (「我會游泳」 - {厓曉游水: ngai2 | hiau3 | yiu2 sui3}); (b) 表示可能性 (「今晚可能會下雨」 - {今晚曉落水: gim1 man1 | hiau3 | lok6 sui3})。
items.en: In Hakka, {曉: hiau3} has two meanings: (a) Indicating ability ('I can swim' - {厓曉游水: ngai2 | hiau3 | yiu2 sui3}); (b) Indicating possibility ('It might rain tonight' - {今晚曉落水: gim1 man1 | hiau3 | lok6 sui3}).

items.zh: 連接詞{摎: lau1}，用法相當於廣州話的「同」。
items.en: The conjunction {摎: lau1} is used like 「同」 ('and' or 'with') in Cantonese.

items.zh: 客家話的{恁: an2}相當於廣州話的「咁」。
items.en: Hakka's {恁: an2} is equivalent to Cantonese's 「咁」 ('so' or 'this').

items.zh: {做乜介: zo4 mak5 gai4}有兩個意思，通常是「為什麼」，但也可以是「做什麼」。
items.en: {做乜介: zo4 mak5 gai4} has two meanings: usually 'why', but it can also mean 'what are you doing'.

items.zh: 媽媽有兩個稱呼：{阿媽: a1 ma1}是**面稱**，{阿㜆: a1 mi1}是**背稱**。
items.en: There are two terms for mother: {阿媽: a1 ma1} is used when addressing her directly, {阿㜆: a1 mi1} is used when referring to her indirectly.

items.zh: {屋卡: vuk5 ka1}本來是{屋: vuk5}{下: ha1}的變音，但為免引起誤會，寫作{屋卡: vuk5 ka1}。
items.en: {屋卡: vuk5 ka1} is originally a sound change from {屋: vuk5}{下: ha1}, but it is written as {屋卡: vuk5 ka1} to avoid misunderstanding.

items.zh: {曉多少: hiau3 | do1 sau3}是比較傳統的說法，也可以說{曉少少: hiau3 | sau3 sau3}。
items.en: {曉多少: hiau3 | do1 sau3} is a more traditional way of saying 'know a little', but {曉少少: hiau3 | sau3 sau3} is also used.
